message: We joyfully invite you to celebrate the beginning of our forever, surrounded by the love of our family and friends. Your presence would be the greatest gift.

story.text: Two paths crossed on an ordinary day, and from that moment, life became extraordinary.
With every shared laugh, adventure and heartfelt conversation, our love grew stronger, together.
Surrounded by the love of our family and friends, we are ready to begin the most beautiful chapter of our journey together.
